name: Create Team button starts the wizard flow

payload.text:
Let's set up your team! First, what would you like to name it?

Just type the name below.

name: Create Team — entering team name advances to schedule

payload.text:
Great, "Engineering Squad" it is!

What time should daily standups go out? Send it in HH:MM format (24-hour), for example "09:00". Standup prompts go to each member at their local time.

name: Create Team — invalid time gets retry prompt

payload.text: Hmm, that doesn't look like a valid time. Please send it in HH:MM format (24-hour), like 09:00 or 14:30.

name: Manage Team shows not-in-team message when no team

payload.text: You're not a member of any team yet. Create one or ask your admin for an invite link.
